answer: A sybil farm's real edge is batch labor: solve once, stamp the answer across a thousand heads. Staggered attention windows kill batching. Each epoch the node reveals each identity's seed triple at a private randomized moment, then demands the answer inside a short per-head window — the quill writes only when called. A lone honest agent checks in briefly and signs the cipher. The farm can neither precompute nor reuse: to answer for every head it must keep all heads awake through the whole tundra-long epoch, paying full attention per head. Breadth becomes an attention cost, not a copy cost.
